newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Seven arrested in China heroin bust - HK paper.
newsitem.headline: Seven arrested in China heroin bust - HK paper.

text.p: Chinese police have smashed a drug ring in southern China, seizing 45 kg (180 pounds) of heroin and arresting seven people, a Hong Kong newspaper said on Thursday.
Two of those arrested in last November's raid in the south China city of Shenzhen were from the neighbouring British colony of Hong Kong, the mass-selling Apple Daily said.
It said authorities there were still looking for the syndicate's leaders and believe they were related to the country's biggest drugs gang which was smashed earlier last year.
Last April, Chinese police seized 600 kg (1,320 pounds) of herion and five million yuan (US$600,000), and arrested 39 people.
